facts.label: Schwarz reflection / realness
facts.name: C1_realness
facts.stmt: def C1_realness : Coupling := fun (Φ : ℝ → ℂ) => ∀ t : ℝ, (Φ t).im = 0

facts.label: Euler / multiplicative
facts.name: C2_halfplane_nonvanishing
facts.stmt:
def C2_halfplane_nonvanishing : Coupling := fun (Φ : ℝ → ℂ) =>
  ∀ s : ℂ, 1 < s.re → mellin Φ (s / 2) ≠ 0

facts.label: functional equation / theta transformation
facts.name: C3_theta_transformation
facts.stmt:
def C3_theta_transformation : Coupling := fun (Φ : ℝ → ℂ) =>
  ∀ t : ℝ, 0 < t → Φ (1 / t) = Real.sqrt t * Φ t + (Real.sqrt t - 1) / 2

facts.label: modular / PSL2(Z)
facts.name: C4_modularity
facts.stmt:
def C4_modularity : Coupling := fun (Φ : ℝ → ℂ) =>
  ∃ F : ℂ → ℂ,
    (∀ τ : ℂ, 0 < τ.im → DifferentiableAt ℂ F τ) ∧
    (∀ t : ℝ, 0 < t → F (Complex.I * t) = 2 * Φ t + 1) ∧
    (∀ τ : ℂ, F (2 + τ) = F τ) ∧
    (∀ τ : ℂ, 0 < τ.im → F (-1 / τ) = (-Complex.I * τ) ^ (1 / 2 : ℂ) * F τ)

facts.label: spectral
facts.name: C5_input
facts.stmt:
def C5_input : Coupling := fun (Φ : ℝ → ℂ) =>
  ∃ μ : ℤ → ℝ, (∀ n : ℤ, 0 ≤ μ n) ∧
    ∀ t : ℝ, 0 < t → HasSum (fun n : ℤ => ((Real.exp (-Real.pi * μ n * t) : ℝ) : ℂ)) (2 * Φ t + 1)

facts.label: Cauchy-Riemann / local analyticity
facts.name: C6_holomorphic_extension
facts.stmt:
def C6_holomorphic_extension : Coupling := fun (Φ : ℝ → ℂ) =>
  ∃ F : ℂ → ℂ, (∀ z : ℂ, 0 < z.re → DifferentiableAt ℂ F z) ∧
    ∀ t : ℝ, 0 < t → F (t : ℂ) = Φ t

facts.label: Hadamard
facts.name: C7_entirety
facts.stmt:
def C7_entirety : Coupling := fun (Φ : ℝ → ℂ) =>
  ∃ G : ℂ → ℂ, Differentiable ℂ G ∧
    ∀ s : ℂ, 1 < s.re → G s = mellin Φ (s / 2) + 1 / s + 1 / (1 - s)

facts.label: Hadamard
facts.name: C7_order
facts.stmt:
def C7_order : Coupling := fun (Φ : ℝ → ℂ) =>
  ∃ G : ℂ → ℂ, Differentiable ℂ G ∧
    (∀ s : ℂ, 1 < s.re → G s = mellin Φ (s / 2) + 1 / s + 1 / (1 - s)) ∧
    ∃ A C : ℝ, ∀ s : ℂ, ‖G s‖ ≤ C * Real.exp (A * (‖s‖ * Real.log (‖s‖ + 2)))
